profile.lockedFieldTooltip: This information has been locked by your organization.
profile.recoveryLockedBody: Your organization has set a recovery email for this account.

identities.noPrimaryMailbox: Identities are available for accounts with a primary mailbox.
identities.title: Identities
identities.description: How your name and signature appear when sending. The From address always stays the mailbox you send from.
identities.viewOnlyAlert: You can view these identities but cannot create or edit your own.
identities.defaultHint: Instance-wide template used when sending from your primary mailbox. Managed in Organization settings.
identities.defaultCardDescription: Managed in Organization settings. Not editable here.
identities.sharedHint: Identities from shared mailboxes you can access. Managed by mailbox managers.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Customize how Flaremail looks and feels on this device. These settings stay in your browser and are not synced to your account.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language for the web app on this device.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose a theme for the web app.

security.title: Security
security.description: Protect your account with an authenticator app or passkey, review active sessions, and manage sign-in security settings.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.enabled: Two-factor authentication is enabled{{since}}. You will be asked for a code from your authenticator app when signing in.
mfa.orgRequired: Your organization requires two-factor authentication for your account, so it cannot be disabled.
mfa.disableHintRecovery: Requires your password and a code sent to your recovery email.
mfa.disableHintTotp: Requires your password and a current authenticator code.
mfa.disableBodyRecovery: Enter your password and the verification code we send to your recovery email.
mfa.disableBodyTotp: Enter your password and a current authenticator code to turn off 2FA.
mfa.scanBody: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code to finish setup.
mfa.manualKey: Enter this key manually in your authenticator app:
mfa.setupIdleBody: Add a second step to sign-in using an app like Google Authenticator, 1Password, or Authy.
mfa.recoveryCodeSent: We sent a verification code to your recovery email.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: These are the devices and browsers currently signed in to your account.
sessions.confirmAllBody: This will sign you out on every device, including this browser. You will need to sign in again.
sessions.confirmOthersBody: This will sign out every session except the one you are using now.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.unsupported: Passkeys are not supported in this browser.
passkeys.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face, or device PIN.
passkeys.removePasswordHelp: Enter your password to remove this passkey.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Create scoped API keys for scripts and integrations. Effective access is your account permissions intersected with the scopes you choose.
apiKeys.dialogDescription: Choose a name and the narrowest scopes this key needs.
apiKeys.secretBody: Save this secret now. You will not be able to see it again.
apiKeys.scopesHelp: Start with search, then expand only the groups you need.
apiKeys.revokeConfirmBodyFallback: This will immediately disable this API key.

connectedApps.title: Connected apps
connectedApps.description: OIDC clients you have authorized. Revoking signs them out of refresh access until you consent again.

intendantPassword.title: Recovery account password
intendantPassword.description: The intendant password is randomly generated and never chosen by you. Regenerating replaces the current password immediately — store the new one somewhere safe.
intendantPassword.newBody: Copy this password now. It will not be shown again after you close this dialog.
intendantPassword.rotatedBody: The previous intendant password no longer works.
intendantPassword.confirmBody: This immediately replaces the current password with a new random secret. You will need the new password the next time you sign in.
intendantPassword.confirmMfaHint: Enter a code from your authenticator app to confirm.
